title: Zyph Hub V2
features:
Zyph hub is a roblox gui that uses Emper reanimate to animate hats.

[THE HATS IN THIS SCRIPT ARE NOT FREE!!!!]

Hats needed:
https://www.roblox.com/catalog/11263254795/Dummy-Head-For-Headless

https://www.roblox.com/catalog/14768678294/Torso-Extension

Enjoy Zyph hub!
